asr.full_text: So this is the larger timeframe for AVAX. It is not a chart that I'd find very bullish overall. It's a pretty questionable chart. I guess this becomes quite clear when looking at the larger timeframe here. You see that this is not a long-term uptrend, yeah. I mean it started before, yeah, but it was only a three-wave move up here on the Coinbase chart into the all-time highs. Then we had a five wave decline, another rally, a lower high, and now we're kind of trying to form a higher low there. In the last update, I think, which I published a few days ago, I think, or maybe late last week, I said we have a support area here. Specifically, the area around 12.50 would be relevant because that's the 78.6 retracement of the rally after the October Lowes 2023. And we have a pretty messy overlapping corrective pullback. It does look like five waves down but it could be a complex w x y x z structure. Super complex correction, very rare. I don't use that pattern like lightly yeah... It is a very complex corrective pullback. And normally in for any bullish count to play out, we need to hold around the 78.6 Fib level. But it's not very clearly bullish, right? So we give it a little bit more room if it needs to. But then also we have this lower boundary line here of the trend channel or wedge pattern. So that's why we are watching here for reaction. Now, the thing is, the reaction, I think, is clearly only in three waves so far. So let's take a look at the short-term Avex chart here. And, yeah, it's clearly in three waves so far. And we have hit the first resistance. So this is obviously the four-hour time frame and you can see that the nearest support area I can offer is between $12.87 and $14. And in this move to the upside, yeah, we're tracking a possible 5UP in the making. But I haven't got any confirmation at the moment that this wave 4 pullback is complete. So, I've got this as a possible meaningful low again too early to say only when we get all these five waves one two three four five we can be more confident that a meaningful low formed i call that wave one and then we can add support for wave two and then trek higher prices from there. For now, we need one more high for a 5-wave move. This whole area between $14.77 and $15.30 is our resistance area at the moment that needs to be overcome next. So, ideally, we get maybe a 5 wave like a fake out above these green lines and then we can add support for the coming pullback. And again, that pullback would probably be Wave 2 then, if it happens. And then it should take us back into the current price region here around the 13 to 14 dollars.
